description: Sensibilité des eaux superficielles aux rejets d'eaux pluviales is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. En fonction de la nature des surfaces sur lesquelles elles ruissellent, les eaux pluviales sont susceptibles de renfermer des concentrations plus ou moins importantes de substances polluantes telles que métaux lourds ou hydrocarbures. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
